_provenance.note: Baselines recorded before the calculator architecture refactor. Any change to these values means a step that was supposed to be a code move altered the optimisation.

rebaselined.reason: scipy.special.kv replaced by the exponentially scaled kve inside the wellbore-storage kernel, where K0 and K1 appear only in a ratio at the same argument so exp(-x) cancels exactly. Verified: the Laplace transform itself agrees to 2.1e-16 (one ULP) across p = 1e-6 to 5e3, and at p = 1e9 the old kv path underflowed to 0/0 and returned 0.0 while kve returns the correct 2.76e-20. The fitted T moved by 2.5e-7 relative — a one-ULP objective change amplified by the optimiser settling at a marginally different point. The new values are the more accurate ones.
